brandContentKeyOverride.title: Brand Content Key Override
brandContentKeyOverride.description: contentKey of a specific brand's own CMS brand record (from Find Brand Record, NOT Find Brand Assets) to attach that brand's colorScheme/typography/button styling. Only set this if the user asked for a specific brand -- never fabricate a contentKey.

contentSpaceOrFolderId.title: CMS Workspace
contentSpaceOrFolderId.description: Id of the CMS workspace or folder to create the email in. If the user named a specific brand, use the workspaceId returned by Find Brand Assets or Find Brand Record for that brand -- don't ask the user for a raw workspace id when it's already available that way. Otherwise confirm it with the user if unsure.

dataSpaceName.title: Data Space Name
dataSpaceName.description: Data Cloud DATA SPACE (a tenant/partition name, almost always literally 'default') -- NOT the data graph name. Leave this blank in almost all cases. Never put a data graph's name here (e.g. 'Real_Time_Data_Graph' or 'HP_Default') -- that belongs in profileDataGraphName below, a completely different field.

elementsJson.title: Elements Json
elementsJson.description: JSON array of content elements, e.g. [{"key":"greeting_heading","type":"heading","text":"Welcome"}]. Supported types: heading, paragraph, image, button. Each element's "key" is chosen by you and referenced later in targetsJson -- there are no CMS block ids to track. For genuine per-recipient personalization (not a segment swap), write a plain placeholder directly in heading/paragraph text: {{FirstName}}, {{LastName}}, {{AccountName}}, or {{Persona}} -- optionally with a fallback, e.g. {{FirstName|there}}. These are the ONLY supported names; the actual data-graph lookup is handled deterministically -- never write Salesforce's {!$Expression.*} syntax yourself, and never invent an unsupported placeholder name. Never use a placeholder in subjectLine or preheader -- it will fail.

headerContentKeyOverride.title: Header Content Key Override
headerContentKeyOverride.description: contentKey of the header image to use in the banner -- either a specific brand's (from Find Brand Assets) or the org's own default-email-template-header asset, per checklist step 2. Never fabricate a contentKey.

includeBranding.title: Include Branding
includeBranding.description: When true (default), wraps the elements with a logo/header banner and address/unsubscribe footer. Uses the org default logo/header unless logoContentKeyOverride/headerContentKeyOverride are given.

logoContentKeyOverride.title: Logo Content Key Override
logoContentKeyOverride.description: contentKey of the logo to use in the banner -- either a specific brand's (from Find Brand Assets) or the org's own default-email-template-logo asset, per checklist step 2. Never fabricate a contentKey.

personalizationsJson.title: Personalizations Json
personalizationsJson.description: JSON array of PersonalizationPoint specs, ONE PER INDEPENDENT AXIS -- e.g. [{"ppName":"Industry_Personalization","ppLabel":"Industry Personalization","decisionsJson":"[{\"name\":\"Has_First_Name_v1\",\"label\":\"Has First Name\",\"criteriaFieldApiName\":\"ssot__FirstName__c\"}]","targetsJson":"[{\"elementKey\":\"greeting_heading\",\"textByDecision\":{\"Has_First_Name_v1\":\"Hi there!\"}}]"}]. Never combine unrelated personalization axes (e.g. industry AND has-first-name) into one entry's decisionsJson -- Salesforce evaluates decisions within one PersonalizationPoint as mutually-exclusive alternatives, not independently-combinable facts, so each independent axis needs its own entry. At most 3 entries, at most 10 decisions per entry. Omit entirely for a plain, unpersonalized email.

preheader.title: Preheader
preheader.description: Email preheader/preview text. Required by the CMS email content type.

profileDataGraphName.title: Data Graph
profileDataGraphName.description: The DATA GRAPH the decisions evaluate against -- this is where the graph name the user confirmed in checklist step 1 (e.g. 'Real_Time_Data_Graph') goes, never dataSpaceName above. Leave blank in almost all cases -- auto-detected from the org. Only pass a name if the user has told you this org has multiple graphs and specified which one.

suppressHeader.title: Suppress Header
suppressHeader.description: Set true ONLY when checklist step 2 found no brand header AND no default-email-template-header asset either -- omits the header from the banner entirely instead of silently falling back to an unrelated org default. Leave false/omitted whenever any header contentKey is available.

suppressLogo.title: Suppress Logo
suppressLogo.description: Set true ONLY when checklist step 2 found no brand logo AND no default-email-template-logo asset either -- omits the logo from the banner entirely instead of silently falling back to an unrelated org default. Leave false/omitted whenever any logo contentKey is available.

title.title: Title
title.description: Internal title of the email content item.

urlName.title: Email URL Slug
urlName.description: Unique URL slug for the email content item.
